about_the_game:
The game is produced using Unreal Engine 5 and uses many next-generation technologies. For example, Nanite can make the model have movie-level high precision. Lumen can provide light and shadow comparable to the natural environment to make the day and night cycle in the game realistic and delicate. In addition, The game is first-person, allowing players to experience the game more immersively.



As a student at Weilong, the school I go to must be the top university! Not only is the school environment beautiful, but the students are also as beautiful as angels, which is very eye-catching



All NPCs can attack each other and even pee! The open world is about doing whatever you want and doing whatever you want.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains slight nudity, violence, and guns, but does not include sexual assault, drug use, self-harm, etc. It may not be suitable for all ages.

All main characters are over 18 years old
